newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi businessmen leave to Russia to discuss joint venture projects.
- Yemen plans a $16 million project to increase the number of animals it breeds by eight percent a year.
- Egypt seeks $1.5 billion from the World Bank and other countries to support its health services, the health minister said.
- Iraq's Rafidain Bank seeks to resume operations in Bahrain after a six-year absence.
- Yemen has allocated $105 million for investment projects in Aden.
